worst_unprotected_fedavg.note: label_flip is the worst unprotected attack by AUROC; NOT sign_flip.

corrected_statement: Worst unprotected FedAvg AUROC degradation (eICU, f=3): -0.123 (label_flip). Sign-flip: -0.065. With coordinate-median defense, worst degradation reduces to approximately -0.021. Small degradation is consistent with evaluated model (LR), aggregation weights, clipping, and attack configuration at f/K=37.5%; it is not definitively attributed to convexity or honest majority alone.
